title: refactor: clarify generation fallback attribution
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Extracts community reward selection while preserving direct public, cross-owner public fallback, and same-owner private-fallback rewards.
- Centralizes the `config.targets[N]` served-target marker across completion metadata and text/image response headers.
- Preserves deduction ordering, served-price reward bases, fallback guards, non-enumerability, and Portkey passthrough behavior.
- Supersedes the smaller #13747 and #13754; the observable realtime ledger correction remains separate in #13751.

Checks:
- Biome on all six changed files
- Gen TypeScript typecheck
- `fallback.test.ts` + `tracking-observability.test.ts` — 63/63 passed
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: Fallbacks Know Their Flowers
gist.blurb: The hive sorted out which garden gets credit when generation takes a scenic fallback route. Same rewards, clearer trail of pollen.
gist.summary: Refactored generation fallback attribution by extracting community reward selection and centralizing the config.targets[N] served-target marker across completion metadata plus text and image response headers.
gist.impact: Reward deduction order, served-price bases, public and private fallback guards, non-enumerable metadata, and Portkey passthrough behavior remain consistent while the attribution path is easier to maintain and verify.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden courier, following several labeled branching paths from a generation terminal to the correct flower bed and placing a pollen reward token there. A small CRT monitor robot helps trace the served-target marker through metadata cards, representing centralized attribution without implying a user-visible behavior change.
